name: snippets
title: Snippets
description: Short texts you paste by keyword, with the date, the clipboard, the selection and more filled in. Create and edit them in the panel, import or export JSON, and on macOS expand a keyword as you type in any app.
author: pal

store.tagline: Paste short texts by keyword, placeholders filled in
features: `enter` pastes the snippet into the app in front, `cmd+c` copies it
Placeholders for the clipboard, the selection, Finder files, the date and time (any format, with offsets like `+1d`) and a uuid
One snippet can include another with `{snippet name=sig}`
Find a snippet by name or keyword; create and edit it in a form
On macOS, type `;sig` in any app to expand it in place, never in terminals or password fields
Import and export as JSON; Raycast's snippets export is read as is

screenshots.caption: Snippets by name, the keyword as a tag, the first line as the subtitle; dynamic ones (braces) fill placeholders when pasted
cmd+i shows the whole text under its name, the keyword and dynamic as chips
Paste into the app in front, copy, edit or delete a snippet
Create Snippet: a name, a keyword and the text, its placeholders explained under the field
